notes.title: Time is on your hand! Line Time is now available.
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

We are very happy to announce that Line Time - a programming puzzle game created by our team with great dedication - is now available! We would like to sincerely thank all players for their patience and support, it is your enthusiasm that gives us the motivation to keep moving forward.

Line Time adopts a simple but depth in thinking design concept, and strives to provide players with the purest puzzle experience. The game has no complicated graphic effects or lengthy story lines, but only delicately designed puzzles, waiting for your wisdom to solve them one by one.

The five basic commands are "up", "down", "left", "right" and "stop" to guide the ball forward. Although these commands may seem simple, their combination will be the key to solving the puzzles as you face increasingly complex maps and rules.

As the game progresses, you will encounter more creative map elements, such as keys, acceleration belts, and portals. These mechanisms not only increase the fun of the game, but also make the puzzle-solving process full of challenges. Players will need to use their logical thinking skills and creativity to solve increasingly complex puzzles.

In order to satisfy the needs of players of different levels, Line Time provides over 200 levels for challenge, each of which has been carefully designed to ensure that it can bring you new perspectives and puzzle solving fun. Whether you're new to puzzle games or an experienced player, we're sure Line Time will bring you a very different experience.

Join us now and let Line Time take you into a challenging game world!
FaMo9 Studio
